name: Phú Hòa Đông rice paper
summary: Rice paper from the recognized craft at xã Phú Hòa Đông. Công báo Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh records the craft and does not describe a taste. Two flour mixes, two distances, and two kiln counts stay.
origin: xã Phú Hòa Đông, Củ Chi. Quyết định 4568/QĐ-UBND, in Công báo Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh with the gazette date 14 Oct 2024, recognizes nghề sản xuất bánh tráng.
howToEat: A serving was not printed. Check on arrival. Tạp chí Công Thương says the batter is poured thin, lifted with a bamboo tube, dried in the sun, and stacked to 100.

Those are production figures, not a restaurant hour. The magazine says work starts at 2:00. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says that before Tết a quoted household goes from about 18–20 kg of rice toward about 25 kg.
where: xã Phú Hòa Đông, on the river. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says more than about 40 km from the city centre. Tạp chí Công Thương says about 40 km. Both stay. Clause 128 keeps the name xã Phú Hòa Đông and adds the old xã Tân Thạnh Tây and xã Tân Thạnh Đông.

taste: Công báo Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh does not describe a taste. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam quotes a maker: rice flour, a little sticky-rice flour in the past, wheat flour at some kilns now, plus coconut water, salt, sugar, and sesame depending on the batch. Tạp chí Công Thương describes the older mix as rice flour, water, and salt.
